effects_note.message: You can customize the on-screen effect shown when a capture completes by entering CSS property values. After changing a value, be sure to check it with Test.

shortcuts_note.message: You can customize the shortcuts at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

retention_note.message: How long capture history is kept (in days). If set to 0, it is kept indefinitely until you delete it yourself.

imageSize_note.message: Maximum width of the thumbnails in the capture history (px). You can set it from 256px up to 1024px.

afterAction_note.message: Sets what happens to a finished capture. With Save to folder, the image file is saved to your save location automatically.

settle_note.message: Time to wait before the capture is taken (ms). If late-loading images or animations are cut off in the result, set a higher value.

deviceScale_note.message: Captures at your OS display scale (currently {scale}%). Turn this off to capture more content, at the cost of a lower image resolution. If a tall web page comes out cut off, turn this option off.

depth_note.message: How many levels deep to look for scroll areas. Raise it if nested scroll areas are cut off in the capture.

capture_full_title.message: Capture the whole page including scroll areas

stage_pick.message: Click the element to capture (Esc to cancel)

clear_confirm.message: All capture history will be deleted. Continue?

save_noPermission.message: Couldn't write to the selected folder, so the file was saved to Downloads instead. Re-allow access in Settings.

save_fallback.message: Couldn't save to the selected folder, so the file was saved to Downloads instead.

error_TOO_LARGE.message: The image exceeds the maximum size ({limit}). Select a smaller element or use Screen capture.

error_NO_ELEMENT.message: The element was not found or is not visible on the screen. Select an element that is visible on the screen.

error_TIMEOUT.message: Capture canceled: no element was selected within {sec} seconds.

error_DETACHED.message: The connection to the page was lost during the capture. Do not navigate away from or close the page until the capture finishes, and try again.

error_NOT_ATTACHABLE.message: This page cannot be captured. If developer tools are open, try closing them. Chrome internal pages such as chrome:// addresses cannot be captured, so try on a regular web page.

error_INVALID_OPTION.message: The capture settings are invalid. Check the values in Settings or press "Defaults".

error_CDP_ERROR.message: The browser couldn't process the capture request. Reload the page and try again.

error_NO_TAB.message: No tab to capture was found. Select a tab with a web page open and try again.

error_BUSY.message: This tab is already being captured. Try again when it finishes.

error_NO_RESPONSE.message: The extension is not responding. Close the panel and open it again.

error_UNKNOWN.message: Something went wrong and the capture failed. Try again in a moment.

error_SAVE.message: Couldn't save. Check the permissions and free space of the save location.

error_COPY.message: Couldn't copy the image. Click the panel once and try again.

error_DELETE.message: Couldn't delete the history. Try again.

error_DIR.message: Couldn't select the location. Try again.
